name: Cube-3 Hybrid Ray-Casting
definition: A hybrid ray-casting algorithm developed for arbitrary parallel and perspective projections of high-resolution volumetric datasets, requiring at most one memory access per voxel per projection without pre-processing.
summary: Cube-3 Hybrid Ray-Casting is a parallel hardware architecture that achieves real-time volume rendering by processing all ray samples simultaneously to exploit spatial coherency and eliminate memory access bottlenecks.
